macros.name: edexplanation
macros.doc: The \edexplanation macro generates an explanation of the best practices into the document.

macros.name: ednote
macros.doc: The main user macro of this package is \ednote. It is used say what you have done or what should still be done at a given point in the document. ed.sty formats it like a footnote, but with a margin note that marks the place in the text, where the note is located.

envs.name: edstub
envs.doc: The ed class offers the edstub environment: \begin{edstub}[⟨exp⟩]{⟨file⟩} marks the content of the environment as provisional (e.g. by turning it blue) and lists an external file (⟨file⟩) as the original.

envs.name: newpart
envs.doc: \begin{newpart} takes an argument that is interpreted as a comment and is treated like an \ednote comment.

envs.name: oldpart
envs.doc: The oldpart environment is similar to newpart but is used for old parts of text copied from another document that still need to be changed in a document.

envs.name: todo
envs.doc: The todo environment is an environment that can be used to mark up writing tasks.

envs.name: todolist
envs.doc: The todolist is a variant of the todo environment which is a is an itemized list.
